newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich flown air cargo rises 17.6 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Munich flown air cargo rises 17.6 percent in 1996.

text.p: Air cargo flown from Munich Airport (MUC) rose 17.6 percent to 75,911 tonnes last year, airport authority Flughafen Muenchen GmbH (FMG) said.
Total cargo including airfreight trucked to other airports rose 9.3 percent to 143,000 tonnes, it added.
FMG managing director Willi Hermsen described the cargo results as "excellent" in a news conference presentation.
Scheduled cargo capacity, especially for domestic and North American destinations, generated strong demand, the authority said.
Two new all-freight airlines, Federal Express Corp and WDL Aviation had now joined Amerer Air in operating scheduled services from Munich.
